monitor.note.running: No verdict before every check ends. A failure shown is final for its check; the run is still “Running”.
monitor.note.cancelling: Cancelling the run: running checks stop, and partial results and evidence are kept. A run that did not complete has no karat.
monitor.note.queued: Waiting its turn: another run is active, and this one is next in the queue ({position}).
monitor.sleep: The computer slept {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} during the scan ({from}–{to}). The gap does not count against the checks’ timeouts.
monitor.step.lines: {count, plural, =0 {no output yet} one {# line of output} other {# lines of output}}
